description: This file defines a Java Swing component 'SensorLiveGraph' used for real-time visualization of sensor data within a GUI application. It manages sensor data acquisition, plotting, user interaction for configuration, and periodic updates.

classes.name: SensorLiveGraph
classes.description: A Swing JPanel component for live graphing sensor data with user controls for auto-scaling, sensor selection, and refresh interval.

methods.name: SensorLiveGraph
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the sensor graph with configuration, default sensor, and UI menu item.

methods.name: createRunnable
methods.description: Creates a background Runnable that periodically updates the sensor value.

methods.name: grabNewValue
methods.description: Fetches the latest sensor value and triggers UI repaint.

methods.name: showPopupMenu
methods.description: Displays context menu for sensor, scale, and refresh options.

methods.name: setSensor
methods.description: Sets a new sensor and clears existing data.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a new sensor value to the data buffer.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Custom painting method for rendering the graph and labels.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Determines the current min/max range for graph scaling.

methods.name: paintLastValue
methods.description: Draws the last sensor value in the middle of the component.

methods.name: paintGraph
methods.description: Draws the sensor data points as a line graph.
